chapter_theme: The adjuncts of effect and cause (காரிய காரண உபாதி): the soul is bound by seven adjuncts and the Supreme by seven more; when these, with effect and cause, are cut off, the soul becomes Siva. The letters of Om and of சிவாய are matched with soul, Supreme and Siva, and anava leaves only through the Lord who is the life of life.

2501.reading: When the seven powers of the soul's adjuncts that must be destroyed, and the seven adjuncts of the Supreme that cling, are cut off together with effect and cause, the soul becomes that Siva.
2501.nuance: The seven and seven are not listed. That the Supreme too has adjuncts (பரோபாதி) recalls 2463, where even the Supreme clinging to a causal adjunct is called impure.

2502.reading: When the thirty-six effect-adjuncts have gone, the soul, passing apart through waking, the dream within waking and the deep sleep beyond the thirty-six, and standing in a ground it has not yet reached, is what is called tvam-pada.
2502.nuance: பேறா நிலம் may be 'the ground not yet gained' or 'the ground of gain'. கனாநனா is dream within waking, one of the graded states.

2503.reading: A is the soul, U is the Supreme, M is Siva in the three padas; one may also say SI is Siva, VA is the Supreme and YA is the soul.
2503.nuance: The verse matches the letters of Om and of சிவாய with the same three. The order reverses: in Om the soul comes first, in சிவாய Siva does.

2504.reading: The Lord is the life of life, unceasing and undying, and lives in the doubt-free distinction from the causal adjunct; except through him, the anava that wearies will not leave.
2504.nuance: ஆணவம் is the root impurity of Siddhanta. விதிரேகம் (vyatireka, distinction) and உபமிதம் (comparison, or what is shown by likeness) are technical terms of logic, and the second line's sense is uncertain.

2505.reading: The harsh bound soul mixes in the seven effects, Parasiva mixes in the seven causes; in the void beyond the world of imagined effect and cause and of word and pada, he is the Supreme beyond the supreme.
2505.nuance: கடும்பசு, the harsh or tightly bound soul. பராபரம் is the Supreme beyond the supreme. The verse returns to the voids of 2495 to place the Supreme beyond both effect and cause.

links.note: 2495 lets go the seven effects and seven causes to reach the voids; 2505 says the bound soul mixes in the seven effects and Parasiva in the seven causes, and the Supreme is in the void beyond both.
Both say the Supreme too has adjuncts: 2463 that even the Supreme clinging to a causal adjunct is not pure, 2501 that the seven adjuncts of the Supreme must be cut away with the soul's.

2503 and 975 share their first line and most of the rest, but differ on two letters: 2503 says M is Siva (மகாரம் சிவமாய்) and VA is the Supreme, while 975 says M is impurity (மகார மலமாய்) and VA is form. On the plain reading they assign incompatible meanings to the same letters of the same three-part word, a near-repeat whose changes point to two different traditions of analysing Om and சிவாய.

2504 calls the Lord the life of life (உயிர்க்குயிராகி) and says that without him the wearying anava will not leave. 2210 says the Lord and Shakti, as the life of life (உயிர்க்குஉயிராகி), are all things, and without them all is the delusion of darkness (இருண்மூடம்). Both name the Lord the life of life and make him the only remover of the dark; 2504 names that dark as anava.
